messages:
alex.k: Heads-up — I'm kicking off the ap-northeast-3 cluster bring-up tomorrow morning. Main concern: artifact fanout to the regional registry and Helm chart sync. Anyone seen rate-limit surprises on image push mirroring?

mira.s: Good call. We hit a throttling window last year when replicating manifest lists across 3 regions at once. We had to stagger pushes + enable parallel workers with backoff. :warning:

tim: For this region, maybe use signed URL pull-through cache instead of full push replication? Saves egress and avoids registry limits but needs a short-lived public link to object storage.

sasha: Signed URLs fine but ops needs a verification step — don't want drift. Suggest a small checksum verifier job that runs after replication. Also we should pre-pull stage images on nodes to avoid cold-start GPU pulls.

alex.k: Agree on verifier. Plan draft: 1) GitOps repo PR with helm values for ap-northeast-3 2) Trigger artifact-fanout job (k8s job) to replicate blobs 3) Run verifier job 4) Canary Helm release to 2 nodes 5) Handoff to oncall.

julie_p: Add cost note: cross-region egress for a full repo sync ~ $X00/day at peak. We should use object storage replication + registry mirror where possible.

mira.s: Example fanout command I'm planning to run (using our fanout runner):

```bash
./fanout-runner --source us-west1://redwood-registry --dest ap-northeast3://redwood-registry \ 
  --concurrency 6 --backoff 5s --dry-run=false --skip-manifests=false
```

mira.s: It logs per-image checksums and retries on 429 with exponential backoff.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Job queued: artifact-fanout-2026-07-12-01 (id: job-8421). Status: queued.

tim: Helm values snippet for canary with nodeSelector and imagePullPolicy: If we set `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` and pre-pull images with `daemonset-prepull`, that should reduce cluster-level pulls.

```yaml
replicaCount: 2
image:
  repository: ap-northeast3.redwood-registry/retriever
  tag: "v3.2.1-canary"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
nodeSelector:
  gpu: nvidia-a100
```

sasha: Pre-pull DaemonSet for GPUs (one-off):

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: image-prepull-gpu
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: prepull
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: prepull
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: prepull
        image: ap-northeast3.redwood-registry/retriever:v3.2.1-canary
        command: ["/bin/true"]
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 0
      tolerations:
      - key: "gpu"
        operator: "Exists"
        effect: "NoSchedule"
```

alex.k: Nice. Operational checklist before handoff: PR merged, fanout job succeeded + verifier OK (exit 0), canary health >= 99% for 5m, autoscaler warming, monitoring tags set, cost estimate posted in ticket. Also manual approval from security if signed URLs used.

julie_p: I'll add the cost estimate and add the security approval step to the ticket.

mira.s: If anyone is free tomorrow 08:30 UTC, join the bring-up channel. I'll post the job IDs and Helm release names there.

tim: I'll be there for canary watch. +1 on staged pushes to avoid registry 429s.

sasha: I'll prepare the verifier pod manifest and a small script to compare SHA256 from source/target.

infra-bot: [ticket-bot] Created ticket INFRA-4923: "ap-northeast-3 cluster: artifact fanout + helm sync". Assignees: alex.k, mira.s.

alex.k: Great — thanks everyone. Will post the runbook snippet in doc once we've validated. :rocket:
